Your Guide to Grab & Go

Choose your beverage, collect it at the counter and take it along. Your Nookaa stop, made simple.

Nookaa is a grab-and-go brand serving beverages only. Our compact outlets are built around the pickup counter, so your favourite sip can come along for the day.

Choose your beverage

Explore hot and iced coffees, cold brew, matcha, teas and coolers. Check our menu for the full selection, prices and add-ons.

Collect at the counter

Order your favourite, collect your prepared beverage and head on. There’s no table reservation or table service.

A brief stop, then onward

Any seating is small and temporary, for a short stop. Nookaa is designed for takeaway beverages, rather than long work sessions or a seated meal.

More to enjoy in the app

Discover beverage rewards, discounts and subscriptions in the Nookaa app.
